name: business-transformation-ai
description: Business Transformation AI (AI Solution Builder) — monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@bta/shared && npm run build --workspace=@bta/api && npm run build --workspace=@bta/ai-orchestrator && npm run build --workspace=@bta/web && npm run build --workspace=@bta/mobile
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && cd apps/api && npx vitest run --exclude "**/*.e2e.test.ts" tests/
scripts.test:integration: cd apps/api && npx vitest run tests/prd-coverage.test.ts tests/rls.test.ts tests/crossTenantAttack.test.ts tests/concurrency-artifact.test.ts
scripts.test:load: cd apps/api && npx vitest run tests/load.test.ts tests/disasterRecovery.test.ts tests/outboxWorker.test.ts
scripts.dev: echo "Run dev per app: npm run dev --workspace=apps/web etc."
